name: chatWhatsapp
title: WhatsApp chat
description: A staggered WhatsApp-style conversation with three to five message bubbles.

vanillasky.useWhen: A grounded customer-service or personal back-and-forth is naturally associated with WhatsApp.

msg1.title: Message 1 (received)
msg1.description: First message — left/received by default. Append |in or |out to override side. Aim for 3-4 messages total; use 5 with date chips only for a real time gap in a 10s+ scene.

msg2.title: Message 2 (sent)
msg2.description: Second message — right/sent by default via |out. Replace the suffix with |in only when the grounded exchange requires it.

msg3.title: Message 3 (received)
msg3.description: Third message — left/received by default. Leave blank for a two-message exchange.

msg4.title: Message 4 (sent)
msg4.description: Fourth message — right/sent by default. Optional; most chats end here.

dateChip1.title: Date chip 1
dateChip1.description: Optional date label before message 4. Use only for a real time gap.

dateChip2.title: Date chip 2
dateChip2.description: Optional date label before message 5. Use only for a real time gap.

msg5.title: Message 5 (sent)
msg5.description: Optional fifth message — right/sent by default.

vanillasky.label: WhatsApp chat
vanillasky.description: A staggered WhatsApp-style conversation with three to five message bubbles.
vanillasky.avoidWhen: The source is not conversational, fewer than three meaningful messages exist, or pacing must be brief.
